summary: Allen et al. 2020 (eLife), Drop-seq of the adult ventral nerve cord of 5-day-old females and males (GEO GSE141807); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005603 with fresh VFBseq ids. 4 Samples / 4 Assays (one library per GSM; two replicates per sex), linked to the dsx GAL4 knock-in and UAS-Stinger alleles (GENO has_genotype). One Clustering with the authors' 120 clusters, whose per-cell assignments (not published) were recovered by re-running the authors' Seurat 2.3.4 pipeline (all 120 cluster sizes equal the paper's): 106 loaded (hemilineage secondary neuron terms, Notch classes for unseparated pairs, adult neurotransmitter classes, adult CNS glial cell, spermatozoon; the authors' neurotransmitter added to hemilineage clusters), 14 held. Summary expression as CPM from the GEO DGE matrices (15,052 genes x 26,768 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.

Load the authors' 120 clusters (Figure 1-source data 2), not SCEA's composite labels or the old load's 20 merged types. The per-cell assignments were not published (GEO, eLife source data, the authors' GitHub, SCEA, Zenodo / Figshare / Dryad / Mendeley / CELLxGENE / UCSC Cell Browser checked): recover them by re-running the authors' published pipeline.

Re-run (projects/allen_2020/rerun/): R_preprocessing.R in a Docker image with the authors' versions (R 3.5.3, Seurat 2.3.4, CRAN snapshot 2019-04-10); the cross-sex AlignSubspace run in chunks of three dimensions in fresh R sessions (it leaks memory between dimensions; dimensions are aligned independently, checked: max difference 0); only the input paths, core count and t-SNE (skipped) differ.

Samples from a cross link the alleles (genotype_includes, GENO:0000222): Scer\GAL4[dsx.KI] (FlyBase's for the paper) and UAS-Stinger (unambiguous; not linked to the paper in FlyBase); 13XLexAop2-IVS-tdTomato.nls not identifiable and inert (no LexA driver), not linked. Stage day 5 of adulthood; tissue adult ventral nerve cord; sex from GEO.

Clusters by build_clusters.py from the re-run's cell -> cluster table and Figure 1-source data 2, typed by the most specific author call (predicted hemilineage, else neurotransmitter class, else non-neuronal cell type), the table's other fields kept as author_*.

Single hemilineages to hemilineage XY secondary neuron; 10B / 15B / 16B / 23B (no FBbt hemilineage term) to lineage N secondary neuron, broad; unseparated pairs to their common Notch class (13A/19A, 20A/22A Notch ON; 5B/6B Notch OFF), broad; 8A/24B (Notch ON / OFF) by its neurotransmitter, adult glutamatergic neuron; monoaminergic to adult aminergic neuron; glia to adult CNS glial cell; sperm to spermatozoon.

Held: undefined clusters and those typed only as neuron, of mixed neurotransmitter identity or neuronal/glial (untyped: typeable only as neuron / cell); salivary gland (artefact: a dissection contaminant).
The authors' neurotransmitter is added to hemilineage clusters as an additional match (adult cholinergic / GABAergic / glutamatergic neuron, broad; add_neurotransmitter_matches.py, 59 clusters).

No neuromere terms from the authors' enriched Hox genes: the authors assign cells, not clusters, to neuromeres, approximately (Figure 3E), and per cluster this contradicts their hemilineage calls (Antp-enriched 23B clusters; 23B is prothoracic).

Expression from the GEO DGE matrices (raw UMI counts) combined into one sparse matrix of the clustered cells (combine_matrices.py), as CPM; gene symbols mapped to current FlyBase genes (14,949 current, 105 secondary, 1 synonym; 3 split and 6 unmatched dropped).
All 120 mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).

checks.check: Re-run cluster sizes against Figure 1-source data 2.
checks.result: All 120 clusters equal the paper's sizes; 26,768 cells (11,650 female, 15,118 male), as in the paper.

checks.check: Chunked AlignSubspace: dimensions 2-3 aligned on their own against the same dimensions in chunk 1-3.
verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 26 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays and Dataset looked up in OLS.
checks.result: All current (day 5 of adulthood, adult ventral nerve cord, single-cell RNA-Seq, DROP-Seq).

checks.check: Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: Gad1 ~0.98 extent in GABAergic hemilineages; VGlut1 ~1.0 in 8A/24B, 14A, 9B; Vmat 0.92 in the monoaminergic cluster; repo in glia; Antp highest in 23B.
